notes.sample: Synthetic demo data from examples/make_sample.py (fixed seed). No real sessions, people, projects, prompts or paths.
notes.tokens: input excludes cache reads for both tools (Codex input_tokens minus cached_input_tokens). total = input+output+cache_read+cache_write.
notes.claude_tokens: Claude Code repeats usage on every content block of one API message; counted once per message.id.
notes.latency: Claude Code tool latency = tool_result timestamp minus tool_use timestamp, so it includes time waiting on a permission prompt. Codex uses item started/completed ms or call/output timestamps.
notes.llm_spans: Claude Code generation spans start at the previous logged event (request start is not logged).
notes.session_length: wall = first to last event in window; active = sum of gaps between events capped at 30 min.
notes.prompts: Claude Code: human-origin user text, excluding meta, sidechain, task notifications and local command output. Codex: UserMessage items in non-subagent sessions that do not start with an injected tag.
notes.task_types: keyword heuristic per prompt; session task type = most common non-'other' prompt type. 'other' includes continuations like 'ok', 'continue'.
notes.health: heuristic: 60% tool success rate + 20% (1 - retries/5) + 20% (1 - interrupts/3), 0-100.
notes.retries: a failed call followed within the next 3 calls by the same tool; 'exact' when the input hash matches.
notes.codex_history_jsonl: history.jsonl prompt count in the window, a cross-check for Codex user_prompts.
